newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks retreat from highs, turn lower.
newsitem.headline: French stocks retreat from highs, turn lower.

text.p: French stocks retreat from all-time highs in mid-morning trade as market waits for declarations from Amsterdam meeting of European leaders.
Brokers caution bourse could react sharply to disappointing news after its strong recent advance.
* Blue-chip CAC-40 index down 3.88 points, or 0.14 percent, at 2,804.64 after sliding back from session and all-time high of 2,825.18.
* CAC-40 June futures contract up six points at 2,799. Support seen at 2,793.
